cohort: 32 patients admitted with secondary postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) to the Gynecology and Obstetrics department of Rangpur Medical College Hospital over a one-year period.
finding: Retained placental fragments and caesarean wound dehiscence were the leading causes of secondary PPH.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was conducted by untrained birth attendants or family members in 28% of vaginal births, while 56% of the cohort delivered by cesarean section.
